status: 54项系统回归检查；含模型辅助场景，历史结果不作搜索质量分数
oracle: Actual search outputs, schemas, fingerprints, cached permission state, fixture effects, persisted state across real process restart; model prose alone never determines success.
isolation: Each case has its own temporary database, source, files and MCP session. No production tool definitions, browser sessions or enable flags are changed.
cleanup: Restore source functions and enable flags in finally, reconcile and verify snapshot; stop child services and remove temporary directories. Cleanup failure fails the case.
browser_scope: Natural-language browser case uses real MCP transport with a synthetic browser adapter. It measures discovery/selection, not live Chrome connectivity.
live: Explicit --live uses configured model credentials in memory. No credentials, authorization headers or full provider configuration are written to artifacts.
natural_language_file_scoring: The discovery/trigger gate requires an actual Filesystem write and a real file containing requested text. Byte-exact content is a separate quality metric; deviations remain visible and are not reported as exact-content passes.
